scope: HOIST landing-page copy, real-world 3x3 gallery, research-media presentation, compact citation

layout.desktop: 3 columns; nine independent real-world excerpts; real humanoid and simulation comparisons immediately follow
layout.narrow: 1 column at 320 CSS pixels, 2 at tablet widths
layout.citation: 25px heading, 12px code, reduced section padding and box width

media.visual_review: Reviewed source contact sheets and edited clips; removed title cards, unrelated ending cuts, encoded black/color gutters and CSS letterboxing. Research crops preserve robot, load and target. Labels are accessible HTML/text alternatives. External clips have source links and DVIDS credits.
media.final_clip_review: Vehicle excerpt tightened to the suspended-load shot; unrelated quay and crane close-ups removed.

manual_checks: Desktop three-column gallery and complete research panels visually reviewed.
320 CSS pixel layout visually reviewed; document does not overflow.
Compact citation wraps on narrow screens.
Main navigation, native video keyboard playback and pause memory verified in Chromium.
Reduced motion and SaveData suppress automatic playback; native play remains available.
preserved: Original research video and image files
Original manuscript HTML, PDFs, and supplementary materials
evidence_boundary: The nine external clips are context only. HOIST evidence remains laboratory and simulation tests with a suspended box. Field deployment and crane coordination are future work.
limitations: Automated scans and Chromium keyboard checks do not establish full ADA/WCAG certification.
Manual screen-reader review, other browsers, and original PDF tagging/reading order have not been fully evaluated.
build_reproducibility: Tailwind scans only src/, so machine-local review files and untracked materials cannot add unused CSS utilities to the build.
